subject: spec-kit
tagline: Build high-quality software faster — open-source toolkit for Spec-Driven Development where specifications become executable and generate implementations.

modules.name: specify_cli
modules.description: Python CLI that bootstraps SDD projects, initialises agent integrations, and injects command templates

modules.name: templates
modules.description: Core templates: spec-template.md, plan-template.md, tasks-template.md, constitution-template.md, checklist-template.md + 9 slash-command templates

modules.name: commands-templates
modules.description: Speckit slash-commands: specify, clarify, plan, tasks, implement, analyze, checklist, constitution, taskstoissues

modules.name: scripts
modules.description: bash/ + powershell/ helper scripts invoked by commands

modules.name: extensions
modules.description: Extension catalog (community & official) with hook mechanism described in extensions.py

modules.name: presets
modules.description: Tech-stack presets (Next.js, Django, etc.) layered on top of core spec-kit scaffold

modules.name: docs
modules.description: Public docs rendered via docfx: quickstart, installation, local-development, upgrade, reference/

modules.name: tests
modules.description: Pytest suite covering extensions, presets, workflows, branch numbering, CLI version, etc.

external_dependencies_top10.purpose: Underlying CLI parser used by Typer

entry_points.notes: Agent-driven slash command; injects spec-template.md into the feature directory
Turns spec into technical plan + research.md + data-model.md + contracts/
Generates tasks.md grouped by user story

capabilities.name: Executable spec format
capabilities.description: Structured markdown spec (User Stories P1..P3, FR-### requirements, SC-### success criteria, Assumptions, Key Entities)

capabilities.name: Requirement IDs (FR-###, SC-###, US#)
capabilities.description: Explicit identifiers that downstream plan/tasks reference back

capabilities.name: Spec → Plan → Tasks pipeline
capabilities.description: Deterministic 3-stage generation: spec.md → plan.md + research.md + data-model.md + contracts/ → tasks.md

capabilities.name: Consistency analyzer
capabilities.description: /speckit.analyze cross-validates spec/plan/tasks for ambiguity, contradictions, gaps

capabilities.name: Clarify loop
capabilities.description: Max-3 [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers reconciled interactively before plan

capabilities.name: Constitution / principles file
capabilities.description: Project-level principles enforced as gates at plan time

capabilities.name: Quality checklist auto-generation
capabilities.description: checklists/requirements.md per feature validated against Content/Completeness/Readiness criteria

capabilities.name: Issue export (tasks → GitHub issues)
capabilities.description: Task list exported as issues to keep GitHub workflow as the roundtrip surface

capabilities.name: Multi-agent integration
capabilities.description: Bootstraps Copilot, Claude, Cursor, Gemini, Codex, Qwen, Windsurf, Trae, Kilo, CodeBuddy, Augment, opencode

capabilities.name: Extension hooks (before/after_specify, before/after_plan)
capabilities.description: .specify/extensions.yml declares hooks invoked around core commands

capabilities.name: Preset system
capabilities.description: Stack presets bundled and applied at init time

capabilities.name: Branch numbering / directory naming
capabilities.description: Sequential NNN or timestamp-prefix feature dirs under specs/

capabilities.name: Offline / air-gapped assets
capabilities.description: Templates, commands, scripts bundled in wheel for enterprise install

capabilities.name: CI / pytest suite
capabilities.description: Pytest coverage of CLI, extensions, presets, workflows

presets.mechanism: stack preset packs applied at init

unique_selling_points: Canonical SDD methodology (spec-driven.md manifesto + concrete template set)
12+ AI-agent harnesses supported from a single CLI
Works offline via bundled wheel assets

limitations.description: No automatic code → spec roundtripping; drift detection happens manually via /speckit.analyze on demand
Tests in generated specs are optional — 'only include them if explicitly requested'
No enforced red/green TDD loop — TDD is the agent's discipline, not a gate
